value.process.step1.title: 1. Clarify the Goal
value.process.step1.text: Understand business goals, constraints, timeline, budget, and success criteria.
value.process.step2.title: 2. Architecture First
value.process.step2.text: Start with a simple, sustainable design, validate assumptions, and reduce future risks.
value.process.step3.title: 3. Build Cleanly
value.process.step3.text: Use OOP, SOLID, modular structure, readable code, and maintainable patterns.
value.process.step4.title: 4. Test Properly
value.process.step4.text: Use QA plans, regression tests, UAT support, and practical release validation.
value.process.step5.title: 5. Release Safely
value.process.step5.text: Use deployment checklists, rollback plans, staged releases, and release notes.
value.process.step6.title: 6. Improve Continuously
value.process.step6.text: Optimize performance, automate tasks, reduce costs, and improve reliability.
